name: Paper Print
oneLiner: Two-spot-colour print on uncoated stock: halftone texture, visible ink registration, and editorial confidence.

effects.noise: 6% halftone dot grid at 4px pitch over accent blocks; 3% grain over the page
effects.misregistration: accent shapes offset 2px from their ink key line, as in a mis-registered two-colour print

motion.reducedMotion: no page-turn or offset reveal; static ink treatment

primary.base: height: 48px; padding: 0 24px; border: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-text); border-radius: 0; background: var(--uiux-color-accent); color: var(--uiux-color-accentText); font-family: 'Space Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 var(--uiux-color-text)

ghost.base: height: 48px; padding: 0 24px; border: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-text); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--uiux-color-text); font-family: 'Space Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase

default.base: padding: 28px; border: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-text); border-radius: 0; background: var(--uiux-color-surface)
default.offset-plate: position: absolute; inset: 8px -8px -8px 8px; background: var(--uiux-color-accent); opacity: 0.14; z-index: -1

default.base: font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', Archivo, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 6.5vw, 5.5rem); font-weight: 700; line-height: 0.92; letter-spacing: -0.03em; text-transform: uppercase; text-wrap: balance
default.kicker: display: block; margin-bottom: 12px; font-family: 'Space Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--uiux-color-accent)

default.label: display: inline-block; margin-top: -0.7em; padding-right: 12px; background: var(--uiux-color-bg); font-family: 'Space Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.6875rem; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase

default.base: height: 46px; width: 100%; padding: 0 4px; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-text); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--uiux-color-text); font-family: Lora, Georgia, serif; font-size: 1rem
default.focus-visible: border-bottom: 2px solid var(--uiux-color-accent); box-shadow: none; outline: none
default.label: display: block; margin-bottom: 6px; font-family: 'Space Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.6875rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--uiux-color-textMuted)

do: Print in two inks: one dark key and one warm accent, over an uncoated cream stock.
Let the halftone and grain be visible — texture is the material, not a filter.
Set headlines uppercase and tight, body copy in a warm serif with a real measure.
Offset accent planes by a few pixels to simulate imperfect registration.
dont: Do not add a third spot colour; two inks is the whole constraint.
Do not use glossy gradients, glass, or neon — this is matte paper.
Do not apply halftone behind text; it destroys legibility.
Do not use pure white or pure black; both read as screen, not stock.
antiPatterns: Cream background plus a grain texture over a standard SaaS card grid — paper as wallpaper only.
Four spot colours and full-bleed photos, losing the print constraint that makes the style.
Halftone dots at 2px pitch, which turns into grey mush on standard displays.

notes: Warm cream reduces text contrast slightly; every pair here is verified at 4.5:1 or better.
Halftone and grain overlays are decorative; mark them `aria-hidden` and keep them off text layers.
Uppercase mono labels need extra letter-spacing and should never be below 11px.
